development.selection: Use compact-reuse only if all development sessions finish, all final audits are clean, validation AUC is within 0.01 of original at each cutoff, and total tokens including learning are lower. Never read development test labels. Otherwise use original.

evaluation.order: Fixed method/database order with at most three active cells (increased from two after a resource-only audit at 21:14 local); a free slot takes the next full sequence without waiting for a method pair. The no-memory rel-stack control may overlap the second development candidate. Selection reads development validation only and preserves its original freeze record on restart. No scheduling or repetition selection based on test scores.

reporting.incomplete: Show every scheduled cell's status. Only complete matched support is used in comparative plots; no winner-selected tasks, runs or cutoffs.
reporting.historical: Do not pool third-party-gateway runs with this official-API study. Preserve archived evidence.
